04 / 2300 · QUICK START

My apartment reference card

Fill this in, photograph it and keep a copy easy to find. Use local official numbers; call emergency services for immediate danger.

Important contacts

It happened — first response

No hot water
Check notices or breakers if safe; document it and report through the official maintenance channel.
Locked out
Use the approved building contact or licensed locksmith; keep proof of payment.
Pests / bed bugs
Photograph evidence, avoid moving items between rooms and report promptly in writing.
Noisy neighbour
Record dates and times; use the building process and avoid unsafe confrontation.
Repair ignored
Follow up in writing and contact local tenant support if health or safety is affected.

Keep the lease, receipts, inspection, photos, requests and insurance in one physical folder and one digital folder with the same name.

Stop before you send money

Scammers use urgency, unusually low rent and remote-only communication. Verify the property, person and payment.

Red flags

Verify before paying

Confirm the address, tour the exact unit live when possible, verify authorization to rent it, read the agreement and independently check contact details.

If something feels wrong, pause and confirm through an official registry, building contact, licensed professional or local authority.

17 / 2304 · PREPARE

Create a roommate agreement

The lease governs the relationship with the housing provider. A separate written agreement records how people inside the home operate together.

Put it in writing

A roommate agreement does not replace the lease or override local law. Everyone should keep a dated copy and verify whether all occupants must appear on the lease.

21 / 2305 · MOVE

My moving timeline

Choose a target date, then work backward. Leave space for applications, approvals and changes.

8–6 weeks

Set budget, build savings, define priorities, research neighbourhoods.

6–4 weeks

Tour options, compare total costs, review terms, prepare documents.

4–2 weeks

Confirm move, book help, arrange utilities, pack by zone.

Final week

Confirm access, pack first-night bag, photograph valuables, label boxes.

Move-in day

Document condition, test essentials, keep payments and records together.

First month

Track real spending, report issues, adjust routines, rebuild savings.
